trace.notes: The input URL normalized to an X/Twitter status URL, but the primary page returned a JavaScript-only shell and a Playwright browser recovery was unavailable because Chromium was not installed in the environment. An official Twitter oEmbed endpoint was reachable, but it exposed only a truncated embed snippet rather than a readable full-text source artifact. A bounded exact-source recovery pass using the status ID and quoted leading text did not recover a confirmed full HTML or PDF representation of the same status with sufficient visible source text for extraction, so the source was treated as unreadable/metadata-only under the parser contract.
Saved JSON output to outputs/parse-paper/2051298982287012297.json and outputs/latest.json.
